case_name: Developer identity (Bloor Homes) without proven ownership/control
commercial_scenario: A named national housebuilder identified as developer/applicant, but ownership/control evidence does NOT establish same-subject control. Tests the role-conflation trap: developer identity alone must never be read as ownership or whole-site control.

commercial_rationale: PRODUCT OWNER SETTLED DECISION (Recommendation Taxonomy V2 Implementation Gate, Section 11): PURSUE (narrowed from PURSUE/VERIFY). Bloor Homes appears as an identified applicant/developer - that does NOT prove ownership, legal control, or whole-site control, but it DOES provide a commercially relevant identified actor associated with the opportunity (the Commercial Counterparty Principle) - do not use INVESTIGATE simply because ownership/control remains unresolved; developer/applicant identity != ownership/control, but is not automatically blocking either. PARCEL_TBD/IDENTIFY_PHASE_OR_PARCEL remain appropriate given the 675-vs-50-100-unit scale gap. NOT_RELEVANT must never be derived from Bloor identity alone - an explicit CRITICAL FAILURE for this case, not merely an unlikely answer.
